value_basis: Nominal gross exports, FOB as reported by the exporting economy.
coverage: Selected bilateral routes among 12 reporting economies/areas. This is not world trade coverage or a supplier-to-customer network.
method: One explicit annual period and at most three HS categories per public preview request. Original reported HS edition is retained on each observation. No mirror imports added. Missing reporter-product-periods and routes remain missing, never zero-filled. Material categories span stages and must not be summed into chip or EUV consumption.
quantities: Not shown: physical quantity units and estimation status vary between reporters and products.

commodities.name: Integrated circuits
commodities.scope: All integrated circuits, including non-AI applications; this is not an accelerator or HBM shipment count.

commodities.name: Computer processing units
commodities.description: Processing units other than HS 8471.41 or 8471.49, whether or not containing storage, input or output units in the same housing.
commodities.scope: A broad customs category including servers and other processing units; it does not identify AI servers, accelerators, or all server configurations.

commodities.name: Chipmaking machinery
commodities.description: Machines and apparatus used solely or principally for manufacturing semiconductor devices or electronic integrated circuits.
commodities.scope: Includes many kinds of semiconductor-production equipment; EUV machines and components are not isolated by this code.

commodities.name: Silicon ≥99.99%
commodities.description: Silicon containing at least 99.99% silicon by weight.
commodities.scope: Includes solar and electronics feedstock. The customs purity threshold is below semiconductor-grade requirements; these flows do not isolate chip-grade silicon or finished wafers.
commodities.uses: Refined polysilicon is used to grow wafers for chips and solar cells. Silicon is also used in the alternating coatings of EUV mirrors.

sources.title: WACKER: polysilicon for electronics and solar wafers

commodities.name: Silicon carbide
commodities.description: Silicon carbides, chemically defined or otherwise.
commodities.scope: Compound feedstock across industrial grades and applications; not a count of SiC wafers or finished EUV ceramic components.
commodities.uses: SiC-based ceramics are used for precision wafer positioning. CeramTec reports SiSiC plates that are finished into wafer chucks used in EUV lithography.

sources.title: CeramTec: SiSiC plates for semiconductor machinery

commodities.name: Alumina
commodities.scope: All covered industrial grades, including material for aluminium production and ceramics. Semiconductor purity and final use are not separately identified.
commodities.uses: Alumina ceramics provide rigid, electrically insulating parts for wafer processing and handling.

commodities.name: Technical ceramics · Mohs ≥9
commodities.description: Laboratory, chemical or technical ceramic wares with hardness of at least 9 on the Mohs scale.
commodities.scope: Shaped ceramic goods for multiple industries. This is a component/intermediate category, not raw ceramic powder, and does not isolate semiconductor or EUV parts.
commodities.uses: Hard ceramics support wafer positioning and other semiconductor equipment functions. Taiwan Customs documented a semiconductor-equipment aluminium-nitride ceramic plate within this six-digit category.

sources.title: CeramTec: SiSiC plates for semiconductor machinery
Taiwan Customs: classification of a semiconductor-equipment ceramic plate, 12 August 2025

commodities.name: Other technical ceramics
commodities.description: Other laboratory, chemical or technical ceramic wares outside the porcelain/china and Mohs ≥9 subheadings.
commodities.scope: A broad residual category across industries, excluding the separately displayed harder wares. Composition and semiconductor end use cannot be inferred.
commodities.uses: Technical ceramics are used in wafer handling, process chambers and thermal management. The exact customs classification depends on the article.

commodities.name: Silicon dioxide
commodities.scope: Chemical silica across grades and uses. It does not represent natural quartz trade, finished quartz glass, or semiconductor-purity material specifically.
commodities.uses: Selected fumed and colloidal silica products are abrasives in chemical mechanical polishing during chip production.

commodities.name: Unwrought tin
commodities.description: Unwrought tin that is not alloyed.
commodities.scope: Unalloyed primary metal for all uses; excludes tin alloys and scrap. The code does not identify EUV-quality material or light-source consumption.
commodities.uses: ASML EUV light sources produce plasma by striking molten tin droplets with laser pulses.

sources.title: ASML: creating EUV light from tin droplets

commodities.name: Molybdenum & articles
commodities.description: Molybdenum metal and articles, including waste and scrap.
commodities.scope: A broad four-digit category covering powders, unwrought metal, worked articles and scrap. It does not isolate mirror coatings or EUV-grade material.
commodities.uses: ZEISS coats EUV mirrors with alternating nanometre-scale molybdenum and silicon layers.

materials_methodology: These eight disjoint HS categories cover raw materials and intermediate goods relevant to chips or EUV machinery. They measure broad material markets, not verified deliveries to chipmakers or ASML. They span successive value-chain stages and must not be summed as an AI-input total. Code and subheading wording were checked in WCO HS 2012, 2017 and 2022; preserve each trade record's reported classification edition. Manufacturer examples establish material applications, not the exact customs code of each branded product.
